observer: root native vision, informed by prior text and candidate
scope_note: Whole page localization only; detailed observation of complete f115v37-40. Crops retain marginal stars and unavoidable adjacent-line fragments, which were not transcribed or evaluated. Coordinates are source pixels; field boxes are approximate contextual regions, not glyph segmentation.

fields.observation: Four consecutive target lines identified by their line openings and the target sequence in the second line. The four lines form a continuous paragraph-sized block beside marginal star marks; last target line is shorter than the preceding lines.
fields.limitation: Line numbers and expected identities supplied by exposed transcriptions. The image does not independently certify every one of the 110 alternative-reader groups.

fields.observation: The short forms corresponding to o/l/r occupy one baseline within the second continuous text line. Visible inter-form gaps; no list cells, bullets, separate item lines, bracket or other distinct member-delimiting device.
fields.limitation: ABSENT refers to authorial list-specific delimitation under the registered rule, not to the absence of gaps. Ordinary spaced prose can contain implicit lists.

fields.observation: After the short forms, the aiiin-like group and the chkain/sham region continue on the same text line. No separate rule, bracket, connector, column heading or visible total device links all proposed members to that group.
fields.limitation: Unread preceding/following words could carry an implicit grammatical relationship. Their meaning is not supplied by this image.

fields.observation: The whole llchs-to-sham span is visible. The three short shapes have visible gaps and do not appear as one unbroken ink stroke. Following minim-like strokes belong to a compact group; exact glyph identity and minim count are not independently resolved. ZL/RF o l r and IT olr remain alternative segmentation records.
fields.limitation: Ink separation alone cannot select manuscript word boundaries, three referents, a numeral, or a translation; no spacing metric or new transcription rule was fitted.

fields.observation: The other three target lines are horizontal runs of spaced groups, with a shorter final line. No parallel list cells, member columns or value column recur. Marginal stars mark blocks of text, not each of the three short forms.
fields.limitation: This assesses visible organization only. Repeated syntax or semantic structure in the unread words remains unknown.

claims_excluded: confirmed plant or other word meaning
